skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
Clothes Wiš'adel collected in the Confessarius ruins.
Though scavenged, they are simultaneously practical and aesthetically pleasing.

skins.name: Default Outfit
skins.content:
As ever, explosions follow in her wake, and people call her a madwoman.
But beneath her scarlet attire lies an unshakeable determination and unstoppable drive.

skins.name: Supernova
skins.content: Test Collection Series/Supernova. Clothes Wiš'adel wears when stepping into the unknown of space to corral Originium run wild. According to her, since she's here to clean up the trash, she should wear something suitable for the occasion.
skins.quote: 'We're finally here, Doctor. Is this ship floating out in space supposed to be an old haunt of yours? What, feeling anxious? Well too bad, you don't have a choice. 'Wiš'adel', here to destroy your Originium project now that it's running wild.'
